note: Equibase standardized start comments support Break/Broke as the North American Flat start-event sense; kept distinct from harness gait Break.
Current Jockey Club glossary directly defines running on/against the rails and moving a horse close to the rail.
Equibase standardized comments define wide positioning such as Wide Early and Swung Wide; scope narrowed to North America/Regional.
Equibase and The Jockey Club directly define Boxed/Boxed In as lacking racing room because other horses block progress.
Current Jockey Club glossary directly defines Turn Of Foot as acceleration in the closing stages; global scope removed.
Equibase directly defines Eased as a beaten horse being allowed to gallop under no pressure; seed generic slowdown meaning was narrowed.
HKJC explicitly distinguishes LR Lost rider from UR Unseated rider; Equibase independently defines Lost Jockey as a rider falling off.
Current USTA X = Break is the North American harness label for the gait-break event already modeled by RUN-038 Broke stride.
